title: Revealing Persona Biases in Dialogue Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Measured by evaluating offensiveness and harmful agreements via sentiment analysis across different gender personas, as well as testing for gendered coreferences by checking if the model assumes a binary gender pronoun when referring to gender-neutral occupations.

Evaluated by prompting the dialogue system with different racial personas and target demographics, then applying offensiveness classifiers and VADER sentiment analysis to measure harmful agreements and negative occupational associations.

Measured using an offensiveness classifier and sentiment analysis to identify harmful agreements and negative occupational associations in responses generated when the model adopts different sexual orientation personas or evaluates prompts targeting sexual orientation groups.

Assessed by configuring the dialogue model with different social class personas (e.g., lower, middle, upper class) and evaluating the offensiveness and sentiment of its responses to targeted demographic and occupational statements.
